REQ-RECORDING-COMPING-010SPEC-RECORDING-COMPING
Draft spec		stopped-transport step recording: **D12, R19 §19.3.4.** With the MIDI track armed, clip editor Preview enabled and an insert marker placed, Right Arrow advances by the editor grid and adds held notes. Continuing to hold while advancing extends them. Left Arrow with those keys held removes newly entered notes. Transport need not run. **U:** grid-off behavior, event timing while keys change and undo grouping.draftwiki/specs/recording-comping.md
REQ-RECORDING-COMPING-011SPEC-RECORDING-COMPING
Draft spec		record quantization and undo: **D12, R19 §19.5.** Record Quantization aligns incoming notes to the selected subdivision. For Arrangement recording its quantization is a separate Undo step: Undo can remove quantization while retaining the recording. The setting cannot change during ordinary Session/Arrangement recording; during overdub with Clip View Loop on, changes apply immediately and their quantization is not separately undoable. These are distinct documented modes. Enum/storage values remain REQ-CLIP-LAUNCH-006. **U:** rounding/ties, note-off treatment,draftwiki/specs/recording-comping.md
REQ-RECORDING-COMPING-012SPEC-RECORDING-COMPING
Draft spec		count-in: **D12, R19 §19.6.** A non-None count-in delays recording until it finishes. The Arrangement Position display shows its bars/beats/sixteenths in blue; the documented two-bar example counts from −2.1.1 to 1.1.1, when recording begins. **U:** buffered input during count-in, held notes crossing its end, already-running transport and combining count-in with punch/pre-roll.draftwiki/specs/recording-comping.md
REQ-RECORDING-COMPING-013SPEC-RECORDING-COMPING
Draft spec		recording metronome: **D12, R19 §19.4–19.4.1.** The enabled metronome starts with playback or a clip launch; Preview Volume controls its level. Auto tick division follows the meter denominator. A selected division that no longer fits a bar falls back to Auto, then returns if a later meter permits it. With Enable Only While Recording and the metronome enabled, it sounds during recording; enabled Punch-In postpones that sound to the punch-in point. **U:** tick sample waveform, phase and latency.draftwiki/specs/recording-comping.md
REQ-RECORDING-COMPING-014SPEC-RECORDING-COMPING
Draft spec		Capture MIDI eligibility: **D12, R19 §19.10.** Capture MIDI retrieves recently played input from armed or input-monitored MIDI tracks without prior Record. **U:** buffer capacity, eviction, clear/reset triggers, no-input behavior, controllers, MPE expression and the relationship of armed eligibility to suppressed Auto monitoring.draftwiki/specs/recording-comping.md
REQ-RECORDING-COMPING-015SPEC-RECORDING-COMPING
Draft spec		Capture MIDI in an empty stopped Set: **D12, R19 §19.10.1.** In an empty stopped Set, Capture creates a phrase clip on each monitored MIDI track, in the currently focused Session or Arrangement view. It infers tempo within 80–160 BPM and loop boundaries, and starts loop playback. Material preceding the chosen phrase remains before the start marker. **U:** the detection algorithm, exact phrase, tempo or alignment for arbitrary input; tempo-automated Sets use REQ-017's documented branch.draftwiki/specs/recording-comping.md
REQ-RECORDING-COMPING-016SPEC-RECORDING-COMPING
Draft spec		single-note Capture MIDI: **D12, R19 §19.10.1 note.** With a single note in the first captured MIDI clip, the documented loop bounds are that note's start/end and the inferred tempo produces a one-, two-, four- or eight-bar loop. **U:** how the bar count is chosen, zero-duration input, tempo at exact boundaries and held/incomplete notes.draftwiki/specs/recording-comping.md
REQ-RECORDING-COMPING-017SPEC-RECORDING-COMPING
Draft spec		Capture MIDI in an established Set: **D12, R19 §19.10.2.** If transport runs, other clips exist, or tempo is automated, Capture uses the existing tempo instead of changing it. It selects a loop from the played phrase and retains preceding material. Playing over a running clip on the same track and pressing Capture adds the material to that clip. **U:** stopped/nonplaying occupied-slot placement, capture repeated without new input and collisions with ordinary recording/overdub.draftwiki/specs/recording-comping.md
REQ-RECORDING-COMPING-018SPEC-RECORDING-COMPING
Draft spec		recording takes: **D12, R21 §21.1, §21.3.** Arrangement recording creates take lanes and clips on armed audio/MIDI tracks. Recording over existing clips adds a lane per pass, including looping passes. Existing lanes are reused when no other clip exists after the punch-in point. The latest recorded clip is copied to the main lane and is available for playback. **U:** the reuse search order, first-pass preexisting-main preservation and partial-pass clipping. The manual's reuse condition does not establish a greedy lane-allocation algorithm.draftwiki/specs/recording-comping.md
REQ-RECORDING-COMPING-019SPEC-RECORDING-COMPING
Draft spec		lane visibility: **D12, R21 §21.1–21.2.** Audio/MIDI Arrangement tracks have a main lane and can have multiple take lanes. Show Take Lanes toggles their visibility; inserting a lane unfolds them. Take lanes are hidden in Automation Mode; requesting their display or insertion exits that mode. **U:** display persistence and accessibility/focus transitions beyond these actions.draftwiki/specs/recording-comping.md
REQ-RECORDING-COMPING-020SPEC-RECORDING-COMPING
Draft spec		lane management: **D12, R21 §21.2.** Selected tracks accept Insert Take Lane. Lanes can be duplicated, deleted, reordered within their track, renamed and resized. Delete All Take Lanes removes all lanes; Delete All Unused Take Lanes removes lanes lacking recorded material used in the main comp. **U:** sample-file deletion, undo/redo grouping, linked tracks and edge conditions in unused-lane classification. Deleting a lane is not evidence of deleting its audio file.draftwiki/specs/recording-comping.md
REQ-RECORDING-COMPING-021SPEC-RECORDING-COMPING
Draft spec		audition: **D12, R21 §21.1, §21.5.** The main lane is normally heard; take lanes are heard through Audition. The speaker control or T auditions a take lane. Only one lane per track may be auditioned; different tracks may audition together. When a selection spans lanes/tracks, the last selected lane per track is used. **U:** audition/record overlap, switch timing, gaps, teardown and suppression of the main lane during every audition boundary.draftwiki/specs/recording-comping.md
REQ-RECORDING-COMPING-022SPEC-RECORDING-COMPING
Draft spec		comp copies and source independence: **D12, R21 §21.6.** Enter or Copy Selection to Main Lane copies selected take material to the main lane. Main/take clips are independent copies: editing one does not edit the other. This describes clip content independence, not a second physical audio file. Take clips allow ordinary Arrangement edits and can be copied/dragged to Session slots. **U:** cross-type paste refusal and exact non-grid boundary handling.draftwiki/specs/recording-comping.md
REQ-RECORDING-COMPING-023SPEC-RECORDING-COMPING
Draft spec		choosing alternate comp material: **D12, R21 §21.6.** Ctrl on Windows/Cmd on macOS with Up/Down replaces selected main material with previous/next take clips, skipping empty lanes. A take-lane time selection also moves to the chosen take. Draw Mode copies a dragged take selection to main on release; clicking a take with a main time selection replaces the corresponding interval. **U:** dragging cancellation, endpoint ties, cross-track selections and the no-alternative boundary.draftwiki/specs/recording-comping.md
REQ-RECORDING-COMPING-024SPEC-RECORDING-COMPING
Draft spec		source highlights: **D12, R21 §21.7.** Used take material is highlighted with the track color; unused material is desaturated. Highlights require matching clip positions and properties. Dragging the highlight edge adjusts the split between adjacent comp pieces. **U:** the complete property equivalence predicate, floating-point tolerances and effects of unmatched edits. A shared TakeId alone does not prove that two clips match.draftwiki/specs/recording-comping.md
REQ-RECORDING-COMPING-025SPEC-RECORDING-COMPING
Draft spec		comp crossfades: **D12, R21 §21.6.** With Create Fades on Clip Edges enabled, adjacent comp clips receive four-millisecond crossfades. The documented manual crossfade command also applies to selected clips. **U:** curve law, overlap/minimum-length rules, rounding at sample rates and numerical render output. Four milliseconds is a documented duration, not a measured waveform tolerance.draftwiki/specs/recording-comping.md
REQ-RECORDING-COMPING-026SPEC-RECORDING-COMPING
Draft spec		recorded audio files: **D12, R19 §19.7–19.8; R17 §17.2.1.** Recording File Type and Bit Depth settings choose the recorded sample format. Mono input records mono; other selected audio input records stereo. Recorded media belongs under the Set project's Samples/Recorded; before saving, its location follows Temporary Folder. **U:** naming/collision policy, precise first-save move/copy transaction, encoding details, disk-full/write failure, unsaved close and unused-file cleanup. Sample-reference structure remains SPEC-LIVE-SET-STRUCTURE's contract.draftwiki/specs/recording-comping.md
REQ-RECORDING-COMPING-027SPEC-RECORDING-COMPING
Draft spec		stored lane inventory: **D12403, E-SCHEMA; E-DOCS.** Both AudioTrack and MidiTrack declare TakeLanes. Its nested TakeLanes list holds TakeLane entries and a folded-state field. TakeLane declares name, annotation, height, selection, clip automation and Audition fields, with ClipAutomation/Events holding saved clips. AudioClip and MidiClip declare TakeId. Shipped documents corroborate concrete lane entries and MIDI clips. This requirement inventories stored state; it does not assert allocation, source matching, numeric range, save/restore behavior or how TakeId is generated. Existing document specs govern common fiedraftwiki/specs/recording-comping.md
REQ-RECORDING-COMPING-028SPEC-RECORDING-COMPING
Draft spec		save, undo, redo and deletion lifecycle: **U.** Other than the documented Undo clauses in REQ-006, 009 and 011, no recording/comp transaction boundary or redo result is established. Persistence of an in-progress record, captured history, audition state, lane fold/selection, comp linkage, unsaved recordings and physical sample ownership remains open. Schema declarations cannot settle these behaviors. No recovery guarantee follows from the presence of a saved clip.draftwiki/specs/recording-comping.md
REQ-RECORDING-COMPING-029SPEC-RECORDING-COMPING
Draft spec		cancellation, failure and teardown: **U.** Stop is a documented recording/clip control (REQ-007, 031), but cancel before start, stop during count-in, disconnecting an input, disk full, permission failure, sample-write failure, device/track deletion, closing the Set while recording and process failure have no established transition or error wording. Retained media, final note-offs, retry and rollback results must remain ungraded.draftwiki/specs/recording-comping.md
REQ-RECORDING-COMPING-030SPEC-RECORDING-COMPING
Draft spec		recording timing: **U.** No bound is established for input-to-note/sample timestamp, monitor or record latency compensation, buffer scheduling, punch inclusivity, click-free switching, jitter or real-time capacity. The monitoring-latency preference documented by R17 §17.1 has no numeric transfer rule here. Clip-launch and playback-core timing results cannot be substituted for the recording path.draftwiki/specs/recording-comping.md
REQ-RECORDING-COMPING-031SPEC-RECORDING-COMPING
Draft spec		Session performance into Arrangement: **D12, R7 §7.5.** Arrangement Record captures Session clip launches and their property changes into Arrangement on the appropriate tracks/song positions; it also records eligible mixer/device automation and tempo/meter changes included in the names of launched scenes. Press Record again or stop playback to finish. This produces Arrangement clips without new audio data. Session/Arrangement clips are independent. Playback ownership and return controls belong to REQ-ARRANGEMENT-020 and [REQ-ARRANGEMENT-021](arrdraftwiki/specs/recording-comping.md
REQ-RECORDING-COMPING-032SPEC-RECORDING-COMPING
Draft spec		remote recording actions: **D12, R19 §19.9.** Arrangement Record, transport, track Arm, Session Record, New, individual slots and relative Session navigation can be assigned through key/MIDI mapping. Step recording navigators can also be mapped. These are alternate triggers for this draft's actions. **U:** simultaneous mappings, conflicts, press/release edges and remote action timing; controller protocol details belong to their respective feature families.draftwiki/specs/recording-comping.md
REQ-RECORDING-COMPING-033SPEC-RECORDING-COMPING
Draft spec		take-to-main navigation and folding: **D12/target-U.** From a selected take lane, Left Arrow navigates to the main lane and folds all take lanes. This names the documented lane-focus input and visible folding role, not a global key alias, default, accessibility/animation timing or persistence law. Exact 12.4.3 action remains U. Evidence: retained Comping source audit CMP:B008.draftwiki/specs/recording-comping.md
REQ-RECORDING-COMPING-034SPEC-RECORDING-COMPING
Draft spec		file-to-take input roles: **D12/target-U.** Samples and MIDI files can be dragged onto take lanes from the Browser or platform File Explorer/Finder in admitted audio/MIDI contexts. With multiple samples selected, Ctrl on Windows or Cmd on macOS while dragging inserts each sample into sequential tracks. The latter scope is multiple samples, not a claim about multi-MIDI-file distribution. Supported-file admission, ordering, decoder/format grammar, copy ownership, cancellation and exact-build outcome remain U. Evidence: retained Comping source audit CMP:B026. [Current requirement view](../../analysis/ableton-live-12.4.3/fdraftwiki/specs/recording-comping.md

Draft spec		loop switch text on load: - **S, X.** LoopOn/@Value text true or 1 loads loop on. false or 0 loads loop off. A double above the largest float by half a float spacing or more becomes +∞: 3.4028236e38 and 1e39 give +∞, and 3.4028235e38 gives the largest finite float. - **X, finite converter expectations.** For the exact 32-bit hash strings in the [revision 6 cdraftwiki/specs/transport-state.md

Draft spec		time-signature code text on load: - **X.** Split the value text into leading U+0020 spaces, at most one +, a body and trailing U+0020 spaces. The body is an optional - and then one or more ASCII digits, at most 63 characters in all. 3. A + is not followed by -. 4. There are no trailing spaces when there are leading spaces or a +. 5. The value lies in −2,147,483,648 to 2,147,483,647. Leading zeros are allowed: 00201 is 201, and -0 is 0.
